ModMetaData.name: 自动技能：空目标检查修复
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiverMa
ModMetaData.description:
修复自动技能在“避免对友军使用范围技能”检查中，对没有 Pawn 的目标直接读取 Pawn 属性导致的 NullReferenceException。只把 MyValidate 中三处 Pawn 属性读取改为空安全判断，保留技能选择、距离、弹窗与其他检查。不改工坊原件或存档。
Fixes the NullReferenceException in Auto Ability's friendly-fire AOE check when an affected target has no Pawn. Only the three Pawn property reads in MyValidate become null-safe; target selection, range, confirmation and other checks remain unchanged.
